title: Color Whip
summary: Pure non-representational color at warehouse tempo. No object — no blob, no sphere, no horizon, no figure. Eight six-second dialects: strobe invert, whip smear, phosphor stack, smash zoom, channel chase, hard cuts, vortex spin-up, white hit. The slow sibling is Chroma Bath. This one hits.
visualArc: Kick-locked invert → smear streaks → afterimage pile → smash zoom tunnel → RGB plates at three speeds → six hard hue swaps → vortex past readable → one white punch and wreckage.
